__NOTOC__[[Category:Guides]]
A perfectly-prepared corpse with '''x12'''{{White Skull}} can be created with the processes outlined below. Be aware that preparing a 12-skull corpse requires advanced [[alchemy]], access to an [[embalming table]], and late-game materials such as [[gold nugget]]s and death reagents. It's possible to create a corpse with '''''x16'''''{{White Skull}} ('''''x26'''''{{White Skull}} with [[Better Save Soul]]); however, As part of [[Game of Crone]] DLC, the maximum Gravesite decor has increased to '''x16''' {{Grave Decor}}, and up to the maximum of '''x26''' {{Grave Decor}} with the Better Save Soul DLC installed.

With no DLC, the best result possible is '''x13'''{{White Skull}}. However, grave decorations only go up to '''x12'''{{Grave Decor}} so the additional {{White Skull}} has no benefit for a buried corpse. The best bodies can have upon arrival is '''x2'''{{Red Skull}} '''x6'''{{White Skull}}.

==Tips & Tricks==
*Regarding {{White Skull}}, it is possible to add up to x5 with [[Embalming_table#Recipes|embalming]], and up to x2 through [[Preparation_place#Recipes|autopsy]], totaling x7.
::{{*}}This means a corpse with '''''at least''''' x5{{White Skull}} is required in order to reach x12{{White Skull}}.
*Regarding {{Red Skull}}, it is possible to subtract x3 with [[Embalming_table#Recipes|embalming]] (while likely adding x1), and subtract x2 through [[Preparation_place#Recipes|autopsy]], netting x4.
::{{*}}This means a corpse with '''''no more''''' than x4{{Red Skull}} is required in order to reach x12{{White Skull}}.
::: • Likewise, since {{Red Skull}}are required for gold/silver Embalming, a corpse with '''''at least''' x2{{Red Skull}}'' is required.
*Important Parts - {{Item|Heart}}, {{Item|Brain}}, {{Item|Intestine}} - are the source of {{White Skull}} and {{Red Skull}}, their properties being randomly generated.

::{{*}}This may include subtracting {{White Skull}} or adding {{Red Skull}}; thus, removing such a part may make an undesirable corpse satisfactory.

==Baseline==
This is the quintessential starting point. If a corpse does not yet have these characteristics, then alter the corpse to reach this point, if needed.

===Starting with a 4R/5W corpse {{Red Skull}}{{Red Skull}}{{Red Skull}}{{Red Skull}}{{White Skull}}{{White Skull}}{{White Skull}}{{White Skull}}{{White Skull}}===

# Perform a {{Item|Lye injection}} +{{Red Skull}}+{{White Skull}}
# Perform a {{Item|Glue injection}} +{{White Skull}}
# Perform a {{Item|Silver injection}} -{{Red Skull}}+{{White Skull}}
# Perform a {{Item|Gold injection}} -{{Red Skull}}{{Red Skull}}+{{White Skull}}{{White Skull}}
# Remove the {{Item|Fat}} -{{Red Skull}}+{{White Skull}}
# Remove the {{Item|Blood}} -{{Red Skull}}+{{White Skull}}

===Starting with a 4R/6W corpse {{Red Skull}}{{Red Skull}}{{Red Skull}}{{Red Skull}}{{White Skull}}{{White Skull}}{{White Skull}}{{White Skull}}{{White Skull}}{{White Skull}}===

# Perform a {{Item|Lye injection}}
# Perform a {{Item|Glue injection}} (''Optional; x13{{White Skull}}'')
# Perform a {{Item|Silver injection}}
# Perform a {{Item|Gold injection}}
# Remove the {{Item|Fat}}
# Remove the {{Item|Blood}}

==Alternates==
A multitude of known natural spawns, potentially able to be effectively altered in order to reach baseline.

Once you have the cultist perk (the perk that can let you see the stats on the organs), the easiest way is to add all 3 stats of {{Item|Heart}}, {{Item|Brain}} and {{Item|Intestine}}. Mix/match the organs with your stock as necessary. You need to have minimum 5 {{White Skull}} and 1-4 {{Red Skull}} . The {{Red Skull}} can be increased to 4 by extracting skull (+1 {{Red Skull}} ) and / or doing dark injection (+2 {{Red Skull}} )

===Starting with a 3R/5W corpse {{Red Skull}}{{Red Skull}}{{Red Skull}}{{White Skull}}{{White Skull}}{{White Skull}}{{White Skull}}{{White Skull}}===

# Follow 'Baseline' above. No changes needed.
#The {{Item|Skull}} can be safely removed if desired.

#The {{Item|Skull}} can be safely removed if desired.

# Remove the{{Item|Skull}},  or perform a {{Item|Dark injection}}
